author: Arnav
problem: Read N players and Q events: '1 x' gives player x a yellow card, '2 x' gives a red card, and '3 x' asks whether player x has been sent off. A player is sent off after two yellow cards or one red card. Print Yes or No for each '3 x' event.
bug_description: Checks == 2 instead of >= 2, so a player with more card points (e.g. a yellow and a red) shows as not sent off.

comments.accurate: Scores a yellow as 1 and a red as 2; a player with 2 or more points is out
comments.wrong_behavior: Scores a yellow as 1 and a red as 2; a player is out when their total is exactly 2
comments.wrong_location: Out check verified; check the card points are added to the right player
